Tire Kingdom Joins the Mavis Tire Family

Tire Kingdom was founded in 1972 by Chuck Curcio in a small farmer’s market stall in West Palm
Beach, Florida. Built on a foundation of best-in-class customer service, hard work, and automotive
know-how, the brand quickly expanded across the state and earned a reputation for fast, dependable
auto care. In 2023, Tire Kingdom was acquired by Mavis Tire.

[More About Mavis][89]

### **A Brand Built to Grow**

Throughout the 1980s and 1990s, Tire Kingdom expanded beyond Florida, with stores opening in
Georgia, Louisiana, the Carolinas, and even as far as New Hampshire and the U.S. Virgin Islands. The
brand changed hands several times - first acquired by Michelin in 1989, then sold to an investment
group led by Goldman Sachs in 1993, before being purchased by TBC Corporation in 2000. Under TBC,
the brand continued to grow until a 2015 realignment rebranded many out-of-state Tire Kingdom stores
under the NTB name, with the Tire Kingdom name remaining focused primarily on its Florida roots.



### **Tire Kingdom Joins Mavis Tire**

In June 2023, Mavis Tire acquired the Tire Kingdom brand from TBC Corporation, including over 200
company-operated locations. Today, Tire Kingdom is fully owned and operated by Mavis Tire,
continuing to serve Florida drivers under the same trusted name and commitment to expert service.
Tire Kingdom remains a leading tire and auto care provider in Florida and parts of the Southeast.
Customers continue to rely on the brand for fast, professional service from experienced technicians,
now with the added convenience of online scheduling at [Mavis.com][90].



### Services Tire Kingdom Offers:

Tire Kingdom offers a full range of automotive services, including: tire sales and installation (all
major brands), tire rotation and balancing, oil changes and scheduled maintenance, brake inspections

## LEAN AND FOCUSED

Accuride Corporation is your only single source for lightweight steel and forged aluminum commercial
vehicle wheels. With over 100 years of wheel manufacturing experience, Accuride is trusted by
original equipment manufacturers, fleets, and aftermarket distributors to supply the lightest, most
reliable wheels in the industry.
[Learn More][46]
[ProShield XGT Hero Tile]

## ProShield XGT™

Accuride set out to create an easy to clean wheel protection technology that would eliminate
filiform corrosion on coated aluminum wheels while minimizing the damage from road salts and debris.
All of this, along with a finish that lasts the life of the wheel.
[Learn More][47]
[Improved Steel Armor Hero Image]

## Improved Steel Armor™

Accuride has made the best even better.

Steel Armor™ already provides industry-leading corrosion protection, and now Steel Armor™ provides
even better sharp-edge protection, so corrosion can’t get a foothold. And the new Steel Armor™ uses
less carbon to produce, so it’s better for the environment.

With over 20 million wheels sold since 2014, Steel Armor’s warranty is one of the best in the
industry. Not that you’ll need it.
[Learn More][48]

# Alcoa Turns Raw Potential into Real Progress

Building a Legacy of Excellence for Future Generations

## Inspired by our vision and guided by our values

### Creating Impact

Our vision is to build a legacy of excellence for future generations. We’ll realize this vision by
running the safest and most reliable operations in the industry while growing our people and shaping
the future. We're turning today's work into a stronger future - not just for Alcoa, but for the
industry and world we help build.

video

Policy page][60].

### Our Commitment

Every day, you’ll find us striving to protect the safety and health of our global workforce and our
environment. We actively engage with our stakeholders in the communities where we operate. We are
focused on not just today, but tomorrow as well - for the people and communities who come next.

### Our People

From purposeful career development and inclusive and diverse work teams, Alcoa employees turn raw
potential into real progress. Today, we continue to channel the determination that first launched an
industry. We’re leading with the same boldness that shaped our history - and setting a new standard
that others will look to for generations.

##### Welcome to the AIEC

The Automotive Industry Export Council (AIEC) was established in 1999 as the official private sector
export promotion body for the automotive industry in South Africa. Products addressed include
passenger cars, trucks and buses, original equipment components, aftermarket parts and accessories.

[Find out more ][6]

##### Quick Links
* [Africa and the AfCFTA][7]
* [Automotive Components-Product/Market Matrix][8]
* [Localisation And Export Development Opportunities][9]
* [South Africa - EU, UK and EFTA trade analysis][10]
* [AGOA and the SA Automotive Industry][11]

###### [Automotive Export Manual ][12]

### South Africa

###### A premier supplier of high quality, competitive vehicles, components, parts and accessories
###### to international markets.
* New vehicle production heading for 1,0 million units per annum
* Exports to more than 150 countries
* Light vehicle manufacturers - BMW, Ford, Isuzu, Mercedes-Benz, Nissan, Toyota, Volkswagen
* All major truck and bus companies represented in South Africa
* Over 500 automotive component suppliers
* Compliance with leading international quality standards
* Global sourcing hub and supplier of competitive, quality products
* Gateway to Africa
* Flexible manufacturing production advantages
* Duty free exports into the EU [SADC-EPA free trade agreement]
* Duty free exports into the USA [AGOA trade arrangement]
* Duty free exports into SADC [SADC free trade area]

[SA Banner]
[vehicleImages]

## Vision

The vision of the AIEC is to ensure improved international competitiveness and, for the automotive
sector as the leading manufacturing sector in South Africa, to upgrade its own export value chain as
well as cross cutting value chains to make a bigger contribution to the economic growth and
employment levels of the country.

## Mission

The end result of the AIEC activities will be to broaden the export base by bringing in more
companies that export directly in their own right or by being suppliers to exporting companies. In
addition, the objective is to increase the value of exports of automotive products.

## OUR STORY

Tylico Solutions (Pty) Ltd imports aftermarket and OEM replacement steel wheels direct from the
manufacturer in China. These wheels are then sold into the market place via tyre dealers.

Tylico Solutions is headed up by Clayton De Decker and is focussed on the wheel import and wholesale
in South Africa and exports in Africa. Clayton previously successfully started and operated Aashrod
Trading from 2005 to 2016, which focussed on wheel import and wholesale in the Eastern and Western
Cape, as well as, the Free State and exports in to Africa.



## OUR MISSION

To offer quality products at the best possible prices with short delivery times to our
customers. This is a growing challenge as the competitor base increases. There are similar “looking”
products, however these  are not of the same quality. Also the increasing cost of delivery places an
additional challenge to this mission statement. To overcome these challenges, supplier and
distributor costs are negotiated often, in order to get the best price for the service and quality
offered.

## OUR PRODUCT

We provide product for both the aftermarket and OEM replacement steel wheel segments.

Steel wheels from 10inch to 63inch can be supplied for the following; Passenger car, trailers,
bakkies, SUV’s and taxi’s – 10″ to 17″ Tubeless rims. Trucks and commercial vehicles – 17.5″, 19.5″
and 22.5″ Tubeless rims.TLB machine rims – 18″ and 28″ rims. Agricultural rims – varous size
rims. Earthmover for both ADT and RDT machines – from 25″ to 63″ rims. Alloy truck 22.5 Tubeless
rims can also be supplied.

## OUR QUALITY

We have been using the same manufacturer in China for more than 16 years, this is because of the
quality and after sales service offered. This manufacturer in China has more than 50 years
experience in global market supply, including North America winter wheel supply.We are proud of the
quality wheel offered into the market place.

## About us

### Offer

To offer quality products at the best possible prices with the shortest delivery times to our
customers.

### Service

We strive to give only the upmost best service to our customers.

### Quality

We have been using the same manufacturer in China for more than 16 years, this is because of the
quality and after sales service offered.

### Our warehouse

Warehouses are located in Port Elizabeth and Johannesburg for ensuring a quick tunraround after
orders are placed.

### Our distribution

Transportation is outsourced to various national service providers to ensure all parts of South
Africa and Africa can be serviced.

### Our customers

We wholesale to recognized tyre dealers, such as; Tiger Wheel and Tyre, Supa Quick, HiQ, Best Drive,
Tyremart, Dunlop shops and many more accreditted dealers.

## OUR STORY

Tylico Solutions (Pty) Ltd imports aftermarket and OEM replacement steel wheels direct from the
manufacturer in China. These wheels are then sold into the market place via tyre dealers.

Tylico Solutions is headed up by Clayton De Decker and is focussed on the wheel import and wholesale
in South Africa and exports in Africa. Clayton previously successfully started and operated Aashrod
Trading from 2005 to 2016, which focussed on wheel import and wholesale in the Eastern and Western
Cape, as well as, the Free State and exports in to Africa.



## OUR MISSION

To offer quality products at the best possible prices with short delivery times to our
customers. This is a growing challenge as the competitor base increases. There are similar “looking”
products, however these  are not of the same quality. Also the increasing cost of delivery places an
additional challenge to this mission statement. To overcome these challenges, supplier and
distributor costs are negotiated often, in order to get the best price for the service and quality
offered.

## OUR PRODUCT

We provide product for both the aftermarket and OEM replacement steel wheel segments.

Steel wheels from 10inch to 63inch can be supplied for the following; Passenger car, trailers,
bakkies, SUV’s and taxi’s – 10″ to 17″ Tubeless rims. Trucks and commercial vehicles – 17.5″, 19.5″
and 22.5″ Tubeless rims.TLB machine rims – 18″ and 28″ rims. Agricultural rims – varous size
rims. Earthmover for both ADT and RDT machines – from 25″ to 63″ rims. Alloy truck 22.5 Tubeless
rims can also be supplied.

## OUR QUALITY

We have been using the same manufacturer in China for more than 16 years, this is because of the
quality and after sales service offered. This manufacturer in China has more than 50 years
experience in global market supply, including North America winter wheel supply.We are proud of the
quality wheel offered into the market place.

# Unlocking the power of visibility

## The shift from no-sight to insight, to 4AI and then to the frontier organisation provides leaders
## in your business with the necessary real-time data to make informed decisions.

Our frameworks empower our partners to future-proof their business through digital acceleration,
focusing on people and data-centric journeys. We achieve this using hybrid cloud technologies
combined with the foresight data to make better, more informed decisions.

Through our approach, we are able to take our partners on a journey from “no-sight” (zero-digital,
no data visibility and running the business blind) to “foresight”. That is, the ability to predict
the future using real-time “insight” data and technologies like ML, AI and digital twin, to
make continuous and meaningful decisions based on what will happen.

Our end goal remains to transition our customers into the realm of “4Sight”, using autonomous
intelligence solutions where the technology not only makes recommendations but also implements the
decisions to maximise business profitability, efficiency and minimise risk.

transformation. Our approach enables data and new technologies to amplify an organisation’s

## Specialist corporate audio visual integrator 

##### Craftsmanship, Quality, and Professionalism _

 

These are the primary characteristics found in every audiovisual design & integration (avdi)
project. Each of us at audiovisual design & integration (avdi) is dedicated to bringing you the best
in custom tailored audio video & communications solutions. 

 

Talk with one of our professionals about your requirements.

[+][12]
[Find out more][13]
Our Services

### Ready to find out more?

+

Contact us for a obligation free evaluation of your existing or new audio visual environment
requirements.  

[Get free evaluation][14]

### Our Services

##### Consulting & Design

avdi provides professional engineering and consulting services to create a system design that meets
your needs and your budget.


avdi’s engineering department offers the following services: needs assessment, acoustics, system
design, creation of technical specifications, quotation evaluation, contract administration, and
acceptance testing.

[+ Learn More][15]

##### Design & Build

avdi will design, build, and install a complete and functioning audio visual system as per
requirement specification. 

 

We work closely with our clients to define their requirements and establish a project budget. 

 

Once under contract, our team follows a workflow sequence that ensures the work is done right and
done on time.

[+ Learn More][16]

##### Quotation Process

At avdi our quotation process is impeccably thorough.  Our team goes to great lengths to ensure we
are comprehensive and yet competitive in our offering. 

 

Our hard work and dedication means a real-world budget with no corner cutting and no requests for
further funding.

[+ Learn More][17]

##### Service & Maintenance

avdi wants you to maximize your audiovisual investment for years to come. For a fraction of your
initial investment, our service team can provide you with on-site system maintenance and service.


Our skilled labor and technical staff will schedule cleaning and maintenance visits, which will help
extend the life of your system and identify problems before they occur at inopportune times. 

[+ Learn More][18]

##### Product Sales

avdi represents a full range of audio, video, and communications manufacturers.  We provide
competitive pricing with excellent customer service.

[+ Learn More][19]

##### Service Level Agreements

avdi understand that after sales service support is critical to ensuring business operational
continuity.

 

For this reason we offer custom Service Level Agreement options to satisfy our customer's exact
requirements. We acknowledge our customer's substantial investment in purchasing a quality audio
visual solution and support this investment by delivering agreed levels of support and maintenance.

[+ Learn More][20]

##### Event services

At avdi, we bring industry-leading expertise and cutting-edge solutions to ensure every event we
support is impactful, seamless, and memorable.

 

Our services are designed to support a wide range of events, from intimate board meetings to
large-scale conferences and live productions.

 

We know that each event has unique goals and requirements, which is why we offer a comprehensive
suite of services that can be tailored to meet your specific needs.


[+ Learn More][21]

##### Support for corporate events

Whether you’re hosting a corporate training session, executive retreat, product launch, or multi-day
convention, avdi offers full-scale AV support tailored to your event’s scope and goals.

 

Our experienced team provides everything from pre-event planning and on-site technical staffing to
live streaming, hybrid connectivity, and post-production services.

 

We specialize in creating high-performance environments where presenters can focus on delivery, not
the tech behind it, ensuring every attendee, whether in the room or remote, has a clear and engaging
experience.

[+ Learn More][22]

##### Equipment rental

We understand that not every event requires a full-scale production, which is why our AV Rental
service is designed to provide you with the essential audio and visual equipment you need within
your budget.

 

Whether you need LED walls, projectors, sound systems, or lighting, our high-quality rental options
allow you to customize your setup to meet your event’s specific goals.

 

Our team is here to guide you in selecting the right equipment for a smooth and professional
experience. 

[+ Learn More][23]

## CFAO’s Value Ecosystem in South Africa

[CFAO SA Expanded Ecosystem Image 2025]

CFAO South Africa, with almost 7000 colleagues, offers the sale and rental of vehicles and trucks,
supply-chain solutions, logistics management, material handling, assembly for the automotive
industry, and importing and exporting of automotive components.

CFAO South Africa delivers an integrated mobility ecosystem. We are a regional division of a
pan-African business; the CFAO Group with its headquarters in France, a wholly owned subsidiary of
Toyota Tsusho Corporation in Japan.

CFAO South Africa has a strong expansion vision in South Africa in the automotive sector and other
sectors aligned to the CFAO Group strategy including pharmaceuticals and renewable energy.

With revenue of more than R30 billion and nationwide operations with over 160 sites, CFAO South
Africa focuses specifically on the integration and transformation of the mobility value chain,
manufacturing and localisation of the industry, digitalisation and OEM collaboration, and
multi-brand focus.

## CFAO’s Value Ecosystem in South Africa

[CFAO SA Expanded Ecosystem Image 2025]

CFAO South Africa, with almost 7000 colleagues, offers the sale and rental of vehicles and trucks,
supply-chain solutions, logistics management, material handling, assembly for the automotive
industry, and importing and exporting of automotive components.

CFAO South Africa delivers an integrated mobility ecosystem. We are a regional division of a
pan-African business; the CFAO Group with its headquarters in France, a wholly owned subsidiary of
Toyota Tsusho Corporation in Japan.

CFAO South Africa has a strong expansion vision in South Africa in the automotive sector and other
sectors aligned to the CFAO Group strategy including pharmaceuticals and renewable energy.

With revenue of more than R30 billion and nationwide operations with over 160 sites, CFAO South
Africa focuses specifically on the integration and transformation of the mobility value chain,
manufacturing and localisation of the industry, digitalisation and OEM collaboration, and
multi-brand focus.

Founded in 1994, Exotic Wheel & Tyre is amongst the leading wheel & tyre suppliers with a highly
successful distribution network of wholesalers and retail outlets throughout Southern Africa. We are
the sole distributors of the following high performance tyre brands – Accelera, Kenda & Ovation. We
are also the sole distributors of Ballistic Off Road, Evolution Racing & RS FLAWLESS Performance
alloy wheels.

Exotic Wheel & Tyre is recognized for excellent customer service. We have built an impressive
reputation for offering our customers the finest quality wheels & tyres. All our products undergo
stringent quality control tests and are certified for use in Europe, Australia and America.

#### LATEST TRAVEL NEWS AND UPDATES

#### 20 July 2026 - Port Health Portal

From 1 July 2026, all travellers entering or leaving South Africa from DRC or Uganda must complete
the mandatory Port Health Traveller Declaration online within 24 hours of travel. Submit your
declaration before departure via the Port Health portal to avoid delays at the port of entry.

[ Read More ][41]

#### 29 June 2026 - Travel Advisory Amid Disruptions

We'd like to advise passengers to plan for possible traffic and flight disruptions on Tuesday, 30
June 2026.

[ Read More ][42]

#### 5 June 2026 - Uganda and Congo Travel Advisory

In response to the recent Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreaks reported in the Democratic Republic of
Congo (DRC) and Uganda, the Ministry of Health wishes to inform the public, travelers, and all
stakeholders, that Botswana has intensified screening protocols at all Points of Entry (PoEs),
including airports and land borders.

[ Read More ][43]

#### 25 May 2026 – Zanzibar

Customers travelling to Zanzibar, Tanzania, are advised to take note of a Travel Advisory issued by
the Zanzibar Ministry of Health, effective from 21 May 2026. This follows the recent Ebola virus
outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda and applies at all ports of entry,
including airports and seaports.

[ Read More ][44]

#### Zimbabwe Immigration Update

Passengers traveling to Zimbabwe are now required to complete arrival forms online before departure,
as paper forms are no longer in use. While iPads are provided at immigration in Zimbabwe for this
purpose, completing the form on arrival may result in delays. To ensure a smoother and quicker
journey through immigration, we recommend completing your form in advance by going to
https://evisa.gov.zw/app/index.html

[ Read More ][45]

#### Special Assistance Requests

Passengers with special requests are required to confirm their requests for assistance 72 hours
before the flight, subject to availability.

[ Read More ][46]

#### Book a Single Through-Fare Ticket to Avoid Delays

All international customers are urged to book one (1) single ticket with through-fares, as opposed
to booking separate tickets to avoid flight delays. Please note that it is essential to read the
fare rules.

# Solving youth unemployment through partnerships.

## WHO WE ARE

Harambee Youth Employment Accelerator is a not-for-profit social enterprise that works with partners
to find solutions for the challenge of youth unemployment. Our partners who, like us, are committed
to results that can work at scale – include government, the private sector, civil society, and over
5 million youth. We are working to unlock jobs and break down the barriers that keep millions of
young South Africans unemployed. Our vision is of a growing economy and a society that works,
powered by the potential of young people.

Harambee is an anchor partner in a breakthrough platform called [SA Youth][11] which brings together
many partners to create a single national network to allow young people to access a wide selection
of jobs and skilling opportunities, and for opportunity holders to access young engaged work-seekers
– for free!

### **4.6 million**

work-seekers supported

### **1.6 million +**

young people connected to earning opportunities

### 3,000+

employer partners

### **R45.2 billion**

income for youth

Updated 11 December 2025

## PARTNERS

## HARAMBEE NEWS

# [Inclusive Hiring: Practical Steps to Find and Grow Young Talent][12]

Hiring young people is one of the smartest ways to build a stronger, more resilient workforce, but
finding and supporting the right talent requires the right approach.

[Read more >][13]

# [Sector Growth, Youth Jobs and Inclusion: The Role of GBS and Digital Sector Bodies][14]

The Global Business Services (GBS), IT Outsourcing, and Business Process Outsourcing sectors are
increasingly recognised as powerful engines of economic growth, export competitiveness, and
large-scale inclusive job creation. But competitiveness and inclusive youth jobs don’t emerge on
their own, they are deliberately built through strong ecosystems, with sector bodies at the centre.

[Read more >][15]

# [Hiring for potential: how employers can find young talent beyond the CV][16]

Many employers are missing some of their strongest entry-level hires before the interview stage even
begins.

In a labour market where businesses need people who can learn quickly, adapt to changing
environments and stay the course, CV-led recruitment can be a blunt instrument. It often favours
young people who have already had access to formal work experience, while screening out others who
may have the behaviours, resilience and potential to succeed.

[Read more >][17]

# [The Global Economic Transformation Will Be Local][18]

We are at the dawn of a new age: the climate transition is upon us, the era of hyper-globalization
is receding, middle classes worldwide are under strain, and poverty reduction in developing
countries faces new headwinds. Even without the destabilizing shifts brought about by US President
Donald Trump’s international trade and foreign aid policies, the world would be desperate for new
solutions.

# Solving youth unemployment through partnerships.

## WHO WE ARE

Harambee Youth Employment Accelerator is a not-for-profit social enterprise that works with partners
to find solutions for the challenge of youth unemployment. Our partners who, like us, are committed
to results that can work at scale – include government, the private sector, civil society, and over
5 million youth. We are working to unlock jobs and break down the barriers that keep millions of
young South Africans unemployed. Our vision is of a growing economy and a society that works,
powered by the potential of young people.

Harambee is an anchor partner in a breakthrough platform called [SA Youth][11] which brings together
many partners to create a single national network to allow young people to access a wide selection
of jobs and skilling opportunities, and for opportunity holders to access young engaged work-seekers

## DW25X28 Rim for Volvo Construction Equipment Wheel loader

DW25x28 is a new developed rim size which means there are not many rim suppliers having this in
production, we developed DW25x28 requested by key customer who already has tire in place but need a
new rim accordingly. Compared to standard design our DW25x28 has a stronger flange, which means the
flange is wider and longer than other design. This is a Heavy Duty version DW25x28, it is designed
to be applied by both Wheel Loader and Tractor, it’s a Construction Equipment and Agriculture rim.
Nowadays the tire is designed to be harder and higher load, our rim will give the feature of high
load and easy mounting.

The practice

## Technology should be felt, never seen.

A great home doesn't ask you to think about it. Light follows the day. Music follows you. Blinds
anticipate the sun; the house secures itself at night and manages its own power through
load-shedding. Our work is to make all of this disappear into the architecture — engineered once,
properly, and supported for life.

We work alongside architects, interior designers and builders from the drawing stage, so the
technology is designed into the home rather than added to it.

[Our approach][13]
[Lutron keypad with Welcome, Entertain, Relax and Away scenes beside a fireplace-lit living room at
dusk]

Disciplines

## One practice, five disciplines.

[

### Home Automation

Whole-home control of lighting, audio, climate, shading and security on Control4 and Crestron — from
a single keypad press.

→][14] [

### Private Cinema

Reference-grade screening rooms: acoustic design, calibrated projection and bespoke interiors,
engineered to studio standards.

→][15] [

### Energy Intelligence

Solar, storage and intelligent load management woven into the automation system — the home runs
itself through any outage.

→][16] [

### Commercial & Boardroom

Executive boardrooms, video conferencing and building intelligence for offices and corporate
campuses, delivered with 1 Cloud Africa.

→][17] [

### Hospitality & Lodges

Guest-room automation and off-grid systems for boutique hotels and safari lodges — proven in the
African bush.

→][18] [

### Bespoke & Custom

One-of-a-kind commissions: Bang & Olufsen Custom, Bowers & Wilkins Signature and bespoke Basalte and
Lutron keypads, made for a single home.

→][19]

## About Us

**Over Two Decades of Trusted Automotive Distribution**

Laxmikant & Co Industrial is a Goa-based automobile spare parts trading company, established in 1999
and specializing in the distribution of genuine automotive components across India.

From lubricants to premium braking and filtration solutions, we have evolved into a trusted partner
for globally recognized brands, delivering consistent supply and reliable distribution support.

[ Know More ][19]

## Our Expertise

**Focused Product Expertise**

With over two decades of experience, we supply:
* Brake Pads & Brake Discs
* Automotive Filters
* Performance-Oriented Components

Our portfolio includes globally trusted brands such as Brembo, Hengst, Zimmermann, and ATE, ensuring
OE and OEM-grade quality across all product categories.

## Our Brands & Product Categories

**Authorized Multi-Brand Distribution**

**Brembo**: Brake Pads • Brake Discs • Brake Fluid
**Hengst**: Filters • Oil Modules • Intake Systems • Engine Fluids
**ATE**: Brake Pads • Brake Discs • Brake Systems Components
**Zimmermann**: Brake Pads • Brake Discs

## Supply & Distribution

**Pan-India & Global Supply Capability**

We supply genuine automotive components to workshops, dealers, and retailers across India and
international markets, ensuring:
* 100% Genuine Products
* OE & OEM-Grade Components
* Consistent Product Availability
* Strong Distribution & Export Network

Our focus is on maintaining reliable supply and supporting trade partners with dependable service
across regions.

**Export Markets: **Africa – Northern, Eastern, Western, Central & Southern, Asia – Southeast Asia &
Central Asia, MENA – Middle East & North Africa, Europe & Central Asia – Eastern Europe, Caucasus &
Balkans,
Latin America – Key emerging markets.

## Our Leadership

**Experience-Driven Leadership**

Led by Amit Naik, with over 27 years of experience in automotive distribution, the company is built
on strong technical and business foundations.

His leadership has enabled long-term partnerships with global brands and the development of a
reliable distribution network focused on trust, quality, and consistency.

## Our Approach

##### We operate with a clear focus on delivering reliability, consistency, and trust across every
##### interaction.

##### Genuine Parts Only

All products are sourced through authorized channels, ensuring authenticity, reliability, and
consistent performance.

##### Consistent Quality Supply

We maintain dependable availability and uniform product quality to support uninterrupted operations
for our customers.

##### Long-Term Partnerships

We build lasting relationships with workshops, dealers, and distributors through trust,
understanding, and consistent delivery.

##### Efficient Processes

Our sourcing and supply processes are streamlined, transparent, and designed for ease of doing
business.

filtration components from globally recognized brands.

#### THE NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF AUTOMOTIVE COMPONENT & ALLIED MANUFACTURERS

###### NAACAM is the National Association of Automotive Component and Allied Manufacturers. NAACAM
###### is recognised as the voice of the South African automotive component industry both
###### domestically and internationally.

###### As a member-driven organisation we are at the forefront of industry leadership,
###### representation and stakeholder engagement for automotive component manufacturers. Anchoring
###### our membership base are suppliers to OEMs for assembly in SA as well as to OE export markets
###### and the domestic and global aftermarket.

###### The majority of component suppliers to OEMs are globally owned however there is a significant
###### emphasis on increasing the number of homegrown participants in this space. To that extent,
###### NAACAM devotes many resources towards positively impacting the localisation, transformation
###### and supplier development environment in SA.

RAYONE products are manufactured at our self-owned production base in **Yihuang Industrial Park,

The factory supports low-pressure casting, flow forming and monoblock forging, backed by CNC
machining, precision cutting, surface finishing and final-product inspection. Before delivery,
wheels are controlled through key tests including dynamic balance, air tightness, impact strength,
cornering fatigue and radial fatigue.

RAYONE continues to strengthen product development and mechanical simulation capabilities,
supporting domestic and international aftermarket demand and OEM/ODM programs through original
design, structural optimization and reliable delivery.

## WELCOME TO SLEEPWA PARTE

Building strong relationships is the foundation of great business.
At Sleepwa Parte, we don’t just sell trailer parts — **we connect people, products, and
possibilities.**

Born from long-standing relationships with trusted suppliers and loyal clients, Sleepwa Parte brings
South Africa’s top trailer part brands directly to you. Whether you’re repairing a second-hand
trailer or building your very first one from scratch, we are here to guide you every step of the
way.

With **over 950 high-quality trailer spare parts**, a modern online shopping experience, and
knowledgeable support from our team in Vanderbijlpark, you can always count on us.

**Sleepwa Parte — You will never be alone on the side of the road™**

##### Quality Trailer Parts

Choose from 950+ premium trailer products by trusted brands including Sleepwa Parte, AL-KO, Burquip,
and Henred Leicht.

Sleepwa Parte is a proudly South African trailer parts supplier dedicated to providing **reliable,
affordable, and top-quality trailer spares** across Southern Africa.

Our business was built on relationships — with suppliers, manufacturers, and customers. This network
has allowed us to connect everyday consumers directly with some of the leading trailer component
manufacturers in the country.

## Our Mission

To be Southern Africa’s most trusted **one-stop online store** for trailer parts, offering expert
advice, exceptional service, and unbeatable value.

## Our Values
* ## Quality
  
  Only trusted, durable parts
* ## Service
  
  Friendly, knowledgeable support
* ## Reliability
  
  Fast delivery nationwide
* ## Connection
  
  Strong relationships with customers & suppliers

### About Smiths Manufacturing

We are an accredited Automotive Component Manufacturing Company, based in New Germany, South Africa.

We are proud to supply under licence, a diverse range of localised integrated vehicle systems and
parts for major OEM’s in South Africa.. These commodities comprise of AC Systems, heat exchangers,
together with solutions for washer and reserve tanks. The support of replacement parts for the OES
is an integral facet of our business.

Our products are made under license to International Tier 1 Global Companies, depending on defined
projects and models.

We pride ourselves in delivering world class competencies in lean manufacturing underpinned by a

tooling and products, carries significant APDP benefit and BBBEE credentials to our Customers.

Our focus lies in manufacturing excellence and support of our Customers, Licensors and Suppliers,

a sustainable legacy for all.

#### About TerraTrak

Engineered wheel solutions are what South African based manufacturing and engineering firm TerraTrak
provides to the industrial, defence, automotive and allied industries.

Specific industries include:
* Defence
* Security Forces
* Emergency Services
* Mining
* Earth Moving
* Agricultural
* Material Handling and Mobile Equipment
* Leisure Vehicles

### COMPANY HISTORY

TerraTrak’s concept of non-pneumatic engineered polyurethane wheels was first developed and
manufactured in the 1990’s for the South African National Defence Force (SANDF). TerraTrak developed
the custom engineered polyurethane wheels, for use on South Africa’s flagship Rooikat Armoured
fighting vehicles.

The tyres were specially designed to handle mission specific combat, reconnaissance and
seek-and-destroy operations.

TerraTrak provides a range of tried-and-tested non-pneumatic wheels, including the Puncture Proof
Operational Tyre (PPOT) and the GT run flat insert (RFI), both offering performance and durability
in extreme environments.

### Products

TerraTrak provides clients with engineered wheel solutions based on technical specifications derived
from envisaged application requirements.

The manufacture of the Puncture Proof Operational Tyres (PPOT) and Run Flat Inserts (RFI) is made
possible through TerraTrak’s unique moulding process that allows precise production from
polyurethane, according to the customer’s exact specifications of wheel load, torque and other
relavant operational engineering inputs.

**Unique advantage:**

TerraTrak’s wheel solutions combine the characteristics of a pneumatic tyre and or solid roller
while performing to similiar standards of a pneumatic tyre, without the requirement of compressed
air.

In addition to being competitively priced, our products are environmentally friendly. This assists
customers in reducing their carbon footprint while complying with increasingly stringent
environmental laws.

### RUN FLAT Insert (RFI)

Weight saving on the unbalanced mass of any vehicle is a huge consideration for any heavy-duty
vehicle operation.

The GT Run Flat Insert is the lightest of its kind on the international market, weighing in at just
over 33 kilogrammes, compared to the industry standard of between 68 and 105 kilogrammes.

Custom engineered and manufactured to client specifications including dimension, design and colour,
within competitive turnaround times.

### Puncture Proof Operational Tyre (PPOT)

TerraTrak’s PPOT is designed for use in extreme conditions, where failure is not an option.

TerraTrak’s unique moulding process allows precise production from polyurethane according to the
customer’s exact specifications with regard to wheel load, defined load footprint and torque.

TerraTrak’s PPOT technology has saved the lives of many military personnel serving their country in
operational conflict zones. More than 58 000 of our custom designed polyurethane PPOT rollers have
been used in military applications in such conflict situations.

The PPOT enables the free movement of mounted frames, which are fitted to clearance vehicles that
sweep roads ahead of land convoys to detonate enemy landmines and improvised explosive devices.

Custom designed and manufactured to customer specifications including dimension, environmental
conditions, tread and colour within a competitive turnaround time.

### Services

### Design, Optimisation and Simulation

TerraTrak custom designs and manufactures to the client’s exact specifications and applications.

TerraTrak’s Research and Development department have run comprehensive tests on over 42 different
compounds in order to provide the right compound for the application, ensuring a quality designed
and engineered product to meet the customer’s exact requirements.

TerraTrak makes use of specialised Finite Element Analysis (FEA) software for non-linear
hyper-elastic materials. The ability to simulate the operating environment of the tyre and analyse
the stresses and strains that the tyre will be subjected to in the field ensures that TerraTrak’s
products are optimised and quality assured.

### MANUFACTURING

TerraTrak boasts a 1200m2, state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Carletonville, South Africa.

Welcome to Xtreme
Enterprises South Africa

Partner with Xtreme Enterprises, a top choice for high-quality fashionable alloy wheels. Elevate
your business with our extensive range, unmatched service, and commitment to your excellence.

### What Sets Us Apart?

### Partnership

At Xtreme, we believe in forming partnerships, not just transactions. As your business partner, we
go beyond providing wheels – we offer a comprehensive support system designed to help you grow and
thrive in your market. Whether you’re a fitment centre or auto part accessory shop, we understand
your unique challenges and are committed to helping you overcome them. By choosing Xtreme, you’re
choosing a partner who is invested in your long-term success.

### Smart Solutions for Profitable Growth

Offering competitive rates is only part of our strategy. Our real focus is on ensuring your
profitability through wheels that balance quality, design, and affordability. By leveraging our deep
expertise and supply chain knowledge, we support you in cutting costs, improving margins, and
delivering the best products to your customers, empowering your business to grow profitably

### Invested in Your Growth

Your success is our success, and we take that commitment seriously. Our team brings years of
industry experience, which we’re eager to share with you. Through tailored seminars, workshops, and
one-on-one consulting, we equip you with the tools and knowledge to market your business more
effectively, manage your inventory more efficiently, and increase your bottom line. Our hands-on
marketing training, designed specifically for the auto parts industry, teaches you how to position
your products, connect with your customers, and build a brand that stands out in a crowded
marketplace.

### A Partner You Can Trust

In a fast-paced, competitive industry, trust is everything. Our partner-based approach means that
when we say we’ll deliver, we do. With Xtreme, you can rest easy knowing that you have a partner who
not only understands your needs but also delivers on promises. We’re not just suppliers; we’re your
growth partner, committed to helping you succeed in every aspect of your business.

[Become a Partner Today - Contact Us][22]

### Our History

### 2 Decades of Innovation and Growth

Founded in 2002, Xtreme Enterprises began with a simple mission: to provide the automotive industry
with high-quality alloy wheels that combine both performance and design. Over the past two decades,
we’ve grown from a small operation into the largest importer of wheels in Southern Africa, serving
over 800 dealers nationwide. Our commitment to delivering superior products, coupled with a passion
for customer service, quickly set us apart in the highly competitive automotive and remodeling
industry.

As demand for premium wheels grew, so did our reach. We expanded our operations into neighboring
countries, including Botswana, Namibia, Swaziland, Mozambique, and Lesotho, solidifying our position
as a trusted partner throughout Southern Africa.

For 22 years, we’ve stayed at the forefront of innovation, continuously updating our product range
to reflect the latest trends in the automotive world. Our unwavering dedication to quality and
customer satisfaction has made Xtreme Enterprises a leader in both local and international markets,
and we remain committed to driving our clients’ success for decades to come.

Accuride Corporation is your only single source for lightweight steel and forged aluminum commercial
vehicle wheels. With over 100 years of wheel manufacturing experience, Accuride is trusted by

## ProShield XGT™

Accuride set out to create an easy to clean wheel protection technology that would eliminate
filiform corrosion on coated aluminum wheels while minimizing the damage from road salts and debris.
All of this, along with a finish that lasts the life of the wheel.
[Learn More][47]

## Improved Steel Armor™

Accuride has made the best even better.

Steel Armor™ already provides industry-leading corrosion protection, and now Steel Armor™ provides
even better sharp-edge protection, so corrosion can’t get a foothold. And the new Steel Armor™ uses
less carbon to produce, so it’s better for the environment.

With over 20 million wheels sold since 2014, Steel Armor’s warranty is one of the best in the
industry. Not that you’ll need it.

## LEAN AND FOCUSED

Accuride Corporation is your only single source for lightweight steel and forged aluminum commercial
vehicle wheels. With over 100 years of wheel manufacturing experience, Accuride is trusted by
original equipment manufacturers, fleets, and aftermarket distributors to supply the lightest, most
reliable wheels in the industry.
[Learn More][46]
[ProShield XGT Hero Tile]

## ProShield XGT™

Accuride set out to create an easy to clean wheel protection technology that would eliminate
filiform corrosion on coated aluminum wheels while minimizing the damage from road salts and debris.
All of this, along with a finish that lasts the life of the wheel.
[Learn More][47]
[Improved Steel Armor Hero Image]

## Improved Steel Armor™

Accuride has made the best even better.

Steel Armor™ already provides industry-leading corrosion protection, and now Steel Armor™ provides
even better sharp-edge protection, so corrosion can’t get a foothold. And the new Steel Armor™ uses
less carbon to produce, so it’s better for the environment.

With over 20 million wheels sold since 2014, Steel Armor’s warranty is one of the best in the
industry. Not that you’ll need it.
[Learn More][48]

# Alcoa Turns Raw Potential into Real Progress

Building a Legacy of Excellence for Future Generations

## Inspired by our vision and guided by our values

### Creating Impact

Our vision is to build a legacy of excellence for future generations. We’ll realize this vision by
running the safest and most reliable operations in the industry while growing our people and shaping
the future. We're turning today's work into a stronger future - not just for Alcoa, but for the
industry and world we help build.

video

Policy page][60].

### Our Commitment

Every day, you’ll find us striving to protect the safety and health of our global workforce and our
environment. We actively engage with our stakeholders in the communities where we operate. We are
focused on not just today, but tomorrow as well - for the people and communities who come next.

### Our People

From purposeful career development and inclusive and diverse work teams, Alcoa employees turn raw
potential into real progress. Today, we continue to channel the determination that first launched an
industry. We’re leading with the same boldness that shaped our history - and setting a new standard
that others will look to for generations.

## OUR STORY

Tylico Solutions (Pty) Ltd imports aftermarket and OEM replacement steel wheels direct from the
manufacturer in China. These wheels are then sold into the market place via tyre dealers.

Tylico Solutions is headed up by Clayton De Decker and is focussed on the wheel import and wholesale
in South Africa and exports in Africa. Clayton previously successfully started and operated Aashrod
Trading from 2005 to 2016, which focussed on wheel import and wholesale in the Eastern and Western
Cape, as well as, the Free State and exports in to Africa.



## OUR MISSION

To offer quality products at the best possible prices with short delivery times to our
customers. This is a growing challenge as the competitor base increases. There are similar “looking”
products, however these  are not of the same quality. Also the increasing cost of delivery places an
additional challenge to this mission statement. To overcome these challenges, supplier and
distributor costs are negotiated often, in order to get the best price for the service and quality
offered.

## OUR PRODUCT

We provide product for both the aftermarket and OEM replacement steel wheel segments.

Steel wheels from 10inch to 63inch can be supplied for the following; Passenger car, trailers,
bakkies, SUV’s and taxi’s – 10″ to 17″ Tubeless rims. Trucks and commercial vehicles – 17.5″, 19.5″
and 22.5″ Tubeless rims.TLB machine rims – 18″ and 28″ rims. Agricultural rims – varous size
rims. Earthmover for both ADT and RDT machines – from 25″ to 63″ rims. Alloy truck 22.5 Tubeless
rims can also be supplied.

## OUR QUALITY

We have been using the same manufacturer in China for more than 16 years, this is because of the
quality and after sales service offered. This manufacturer in China has more than 50 years
experience in global market supply, including North America winter wheel supply.We are proud of the
quality wheel offered into the market place.

## About us

### Offer

To offer quality products at the best possible prices with the shortest delivery times to our
customers.

### Service

We strive to give only the upmost best service to our customers.

### Quality

We have been using the same manufacturer in China for more than 16 years, this is because of the
quality and after sales service offered.

### Our warehouse

Warehouses are located in Port Elizabeth and Johannesburg for ensuring a quick tunraround after
orders are placed.

### Our distribution

Transportation is outsourced to various national service providers to ensure all parts of South
Africa and Africa can be serviced.

### Our customers

We wholesale to recognized tyre dealers, such as; Tiger Wheel and Tyre, Supa Quick, HiQ, Best Drive,
Tyremart, Dunlop shops and many more accreditted dealers.

###### DIVISIONAL OVERVIEW

## what we offer

#### Wholesale

Our Wholesale Division at Auto & Truck Tyres (ATT) provides a full spectrum of tyre solutions for
the Consumer, Commercial, Agricultural, Forklift, Industrial, & Mining segments. We proudly offer a
multi-branded portfolio to cater to every price point from affordable options to premium products,
ensuring we meet the diverse needs of our customers. Beyond tyres, we also supply high-quality truck
rims & offer specialized services that enhance the value we deliver.

##### Craftsmanship, Quality, and Professionalism _

 

These are the primary characteristics found in every audiovisual design & integration (avdi)
project. Each of us at audiovisual design & integration (avdi) is dedicated to bringing you the best
in custom tailored audio video & communications solutions.

+

Contact us for a obligation free evaluation of your existing or new audio visual environment
requirements.

### Our Services

##### Consulting & Design

avdi provides professional engineering and consulting services to create a system design that meets
your needs and your budget.


avdi’s engineering department offers the following services: needs assessment, acoustics, system
design, creation of technical specifications, quotation evaluation, contract administration, and
acceptance testing.

[+ Learn More][15]

##### Design & Build

avdi will design, build, and install a complete and functioning audio visual system as per
requirement specification. 

 

We work closely with our clients to define their requirements and establish a project budget. 

 

Once under contract, our team follows a workflow sequence that ensures the work is done right and
done on time.

[+ Learn More][16]

##### Quotation Process

At avdi our quotation process is impeccably thorough.  Our team goes to great lengths to ensure we
are comprehensive and yet competitive in our offering. 

 

Our hard work and dedication means a real-world budget with no corner cutting and no requests for
further funding.

[+ Learn More][17]

##### Service & Maintenance

avdi wants you to maximize your audiovisual investment for years to come. For a fraction of your
initial investment, our service team can provide you with on-site system maintenance and service.


Our skilled labor and technical staff will schedule cleaning and maintenance visits, which will help
extend the life of your system and identify problems before they occur at inopportune times. 

[+ Learn More][18]

##### Product Sales

avdi represents a full range of audio, video, and communications manufacturers.  We provide
competitive pricing with excellent customer service.

[+ Learn More][19]

##### Service Level Agreements

avdi understand that after sales service support is critical to ensuring business operational
continuity.

 

For this reason we offer custom Service Level Agreement options to satisfy our customer's exact
requirements. We acknowledge our customer's substantial investment in purchasing a quality audio
visual solution and support this investment by delivering agreed levels of support and maintenance.

[+ Learn More][20]

##### Event services

At avdi, we bring industry-leading expertise and cutting-edge solutions to ensure every event we
support is impactful, seamless, and memorable.

 

Our services are designed to support a wide range of events, from intimate board meetings to
large-scale conferences and live productions.

 

We know that each event has unique goals and requirements, which is why we offer a comprehensive
suite of services that can be tailored to meet your specific needs.


[+ Learn More][21]

##### Support for corporate events

Whether you’re hosting a corporate training session, executive retreat, product launch, or multi-day
convention, avdi offers full-scale AV support tailored to your event’s scope and goals.

 

Our experienced team provides everything from pre-event planning and on-site technical staffing to

## CFAO’s Value Ecosystem in South Africa

[CFAO SA Expanded Ecosystem Image 2025]

CFAO South Africa, with almost 7000 colleagues, offers the sale and rental of vehicles and trucks,
supply-chain solutions, logistics management, material handling, assembly for the automotive
industry, and importing and exporting of automotive components.

CFAO South Africa delivers an integrated mobility ecosystem. We are a regional division of a
pan-African business; the CFAO Group with its headquarters in France, a wholly owned subsidiary of
Toyota Tsusho Corporation in Japan.

CFAO South Africa has a strong expansion vision in South Africa in the automotive sector and other
sectors aligned to the CFAO Group strategy including pharmaceuticals and renewable energy.

With revenue of more than R30 billion and nationwide operations with over 160 sites, CFAO South
Africa focuses specifically on the integration and transformation of the mobility value chain,
manufacturing and localisation of the industry, digitalisation and OEM collaboration, and
multi-brand focus.

# Solving youth unemployment through partnerships.

## WHO WE ARE

Harambee Youth Employment Accelerator is a not-for-profit social enterprise that works with partners
to find solutions for the challenge of youth unemployment. Our partners who, like us, are committed
to results that can work at scale – include government, the private sector, civil society, and over
5 million youth. We are working to unlock jobs and break down the barriers that keep millions of
young South Africans unemployed. Our vision is of a growing economy and a society that works,
powered by the potential of young people.

Harambee is an anchor partner in a breakthrough platform called [SA Youth][11] which brings together
many partners to create a single national network to allow young people to access a wide selection
of jobs and skilling opportunities, and for opportunity holders to access young engaged work-seekers
– for free!

### **4.6 million**

work-seekers supported

### **1.6 million +**

young people connected to earning opportunities

### 3,000+

employer partners

### **R45.2 billion**

income for youth

Updated 11 December 2025

## PARTNERS

## HARAMBEE NEWS

# [Inclusive Hiring: Practical Steps to Find and Grow Young Talent][12]

Hiring young people is one of the smartest ways to build a stronger, more resilient workforce, but
finding and supporting the right talent requires the right approach.

[Read more >][13]

# [Sector Growth, Youth Jobs and Inclusion: The Role of GBS and Digital Sector Bodies][14]

The Global Business Services (GBS), IT Outsourcing, and Business Process Outsourcing sectors are
increasingly recognised as powerful engines of economic growth, export competitiveness, and
large-scale inclusive job creation. But competitiveness and inclusive youth jobs don’t emerge on
their own, they are deliberately built through strong ecosystems, with sector bodies at the centre.

[Read more >][15]

# [Hiring for potential: how employers can find young talent beyond the CV][16]

Many employers are missing some of their strongest entry-level hires before the interview stage even
begins.

In a labour market where businesses need people who can learn quickly, adapt to changing
environments and stay the course, CV-led recruitment can be a blunt instrument. It often favours
young people who have already had access to formal work experience, while screening out others who
may have the behaviours, resilience and potential to succeed.

[Read more >][17]

# [The Global Economic Transformation Will Be Local][18]

We are at the dawn of a new age: the climate transition is upon us, the era of hyper-globalization
is receding, middle classes worldwide are under strain, and poverty reduction in developing
countries faces new headwinds. Even without the destabilizing shifts brought about by US President
Donald Trump’s international trade and foreign aid policies, the world would be desperate for new
solutions.

[Read more >][19]

# [Harambee In the News: Jan – June 2026][20]

Harambee in the News: A snapshot of where Harambee Youth Employment Accelerator was featured in the
media each month, reflecting ongoing conversations around youth employment, inclusive hiring, and
the partnerships helping to connect young people to meaningful work opportunities across South
Africa.

[Read more >][21]

# [A Review of South Africa’s Data on the Care Economy][22]

The care economy is fundamental to the functioning of society and the economy — shaping how children
are cared for and educated, how people access healthcare and social support, how older persons age
with dignity, and how households and communities are sustained. Yet despite its critical role…

[Read more >][23]

**Over Two Decades of Trusted Automotive Distribution**

Laxmikant & Co Industrial is a Goa-based automobile spare parts trading company, established in 1999
and specializing in the distribution of genuine automotive components across India.

From lubricants to premium braking and filtration solutions, we have evolved into a trusted partner
for globally recognized brands, delivering consistent supply and reliable distribution support.

* Brake Pads & Brake Discs

OE and OEM-grade quality across all product categories.

on strong technical and business foundations.

reliable distribution network focused on trust, quality, and consistency.

Our sourcing and supply processes are streamlined, transparent, and designed for ease of doing

#### THE NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF AUTOMOTIVE COMPONENT & ALLIED MANUFACTURERS

###### NAACAM is the National Association of Automotive Component and Allied Manufacturers. NAACAM
###### is recognised as the voice of the South African automotive component industry both
###### domestically and internationally.

###### As a member-driven organisation we are at the forefront of industry leadership,
###### representation and stakeholder engagement for automotive component manufacturers. Anchoring
###### our membership base are suppliers to OEMs for assembly in SA as well as to OE export markets
###### and the domestic and global aftermarket.

###### The majority of component suppliers to OEMs are globally owned however there is a significant
###### emphasis on increasing the number of homegrown participants in this space. To that extent,
###### NAACAM devotes many resources towards positively impacting the localisation, transformation
###### and supplier development environment in SA.

## WELCOME TO SLEEPWA PARTE

Building strong relationships is the foundation of great business.

possibilities.**

Born from long-standing relationships with trusted suppliers and loyal clients, Sleepwa Parte brings

manufacturers in the country.

#### About TerraTrak

Engineered wheel solutions are what South African based manufacturing and engineering firm TerraTrak
provides to the industrial, defence, automotive and allied industries.

Specific industries include:
* Defence
* Security Forces
* Emergency Services
* Mining
* Earth Moving
* Agricultural
* Material Handling and Mobile Equipment
* Leisure Vehicles

### COMPANY HISTORY

TerraTrak’s concept of non-pneumatic engineered polyurethane wheels was first developed and
manufactured in the 1990’s for the South African National Defence Force (SANDF). TerraTrak developed
the custom engineered polyurethane wheels, for use on South Africa’s flagship Rooikat Armoured
fighting vehicles.

The tyres were specially designed to handle mission specific combat, reconnaissance and
seek-and-destroy operations.

TerraTrak provides a range of tried-and-tested non-pneumatic wheels, including the Puncture Proof
Operational Tyre (PPOT) and the GT run flat insert (RFI), both offering performance and durability
in extreme environments.

### Products

TerraTrak provides clients with engineered wheel solutions based on technical specifications derived
from envisaged application requirements.

The manufacture of the Puncture Proof Operational Tyres (PPOT) and Run Flat Inserts (RFI) is made
possible through TerraTrak’s unique moulding process that allows precise production from
polyurethane, according to the customer’s exact specifications of wheel load, torque and other
relavant operational engineering inputs.

**Unique advantage:**

TerraTrak’s wheel solutions combine the characteristics of a pneumatic tyre and or solid roller
while performing to similiar standards of a pneumatic tyre, without the requirement of compressed
air.

In addition to being competitively priced, our products are environmentally friendly. This assists
customers in reducing their carbon footprint while complying with increasingly stringent
environmental laws.

### RUN FLAT Insert (RFI)

Weight saving on the unbalanced mass of any vehicle is a huge consideration for any heavy-duty
vehicle operation.

The GT Run Flat Insert is the lightest of its kind on the international market, weighing in at just
over 33 kilogrammes, compared to the industry standard of between 68 and 105 kilogrammes.

Custom engineered and manufactured to client specifications including dimension, design and colour,
within competitive turnaround times.

### Puncture Proof Operational Tyre (PPOT)

TerraTrak’s PPOT is designed for use in extreme conditions, where failure is not an option.

TerraTrak’s unique moulding process allows precise production from polyurethane according to the
customer’s exact specifications with regard to wheel load, defined load footprint and torque.

TerraTrak’s PPOT technology has saved the lives of many military personnel serving their country in
operational conflict zones. More than 58 000 of our custom designed polyurethane PPOT rollers have
been used in military applications in such conflict situations.

The PPOT enables the free movement of mounted frames, which are fitted to clearance vehicles that
sweep roads ahead of land convoys to detonate enemy landmines and improvised explosive devices.

Custom designed and manufactured to customer specifications including dimension, environmental
conditions, tread and colour within a competitive turnaround time.

### Services

### Design, Optimisation and Simulation

TerraTrak custom designs and manufactures to the client’s exact specifications and applications.

TerraTrak’s Research and Development department have run comprehensive tests on over 42 different
compounds in order to provide the right compound for the application, ensuring a quality designed
and engineered product to meet the customer’s exact requirements.

TerraTrak makes use of specialised Finite Element Analysis (FEA) software for non-linear
hyper-elastic materials. The ability to simulate the operating environment of the tyre and analyse
the stresses and strains that the tyre will be subjected to in the field ensures that TerraTrak’s
products are optimised and quality assured.

### MANUFACTURING

TerraTrak boasts a 1200m2, state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Carletonville, South Africa.

Trans Active Solutions provide superior quality Truck and Trailer parts and dedicated support with

#### TRUCK & Trailer Parts

Our warehouse stocks all parts and accessories required to keep super link commercial trailer on the
road.  Contact us here for fast and effective personal service, we can have your part delivered to
your business within 24 hours.

 

[Get Quote][10]

#### TRUCK & TRAILER Suspension PARTS

Air suspension parts – Air Bags, Trailing Arms & Shocks. Mechanical suspension parts.

Brakes, Hubs, Fifth Wheels, Axle Seats, Axles, Spring Packs, Slack adjusters, Brake Boosters, Axel
Nuts, Axel Washers, Split Pins, U-Bolts, Strongbacks, Hangers, Rockers, Torque Rods, Torque Plates,
Wear Plates, Spider Brackets, S-cams, Bushes, Pins, Bearings, Studs, Nuts, Seals and Gaskets.

Brake Drums, Hubs, Boosters, Brake Linings, Brake Shoes, Brake Springs, Brake Rollers, Anchor Pins,
Spring Posts, Circlips, Washers, Slack Adjusters, Springs, O-rings, Cam Shaft Bushes, Valves, Valve
extensions & brackets, S-cams and Bushes.

**Aluminum & Steel Rims – **Truck Tyres & Rims, Trailer Tyres and Rims, Consumables and tools.

#### TRUCK & TRAILER Valves & Fittings

Trans Active Solutions stock all Trailer Valves and Fittings including Air dryers & cartridges,
Quick release valves, Square Relay Valves, Loadsensing Valves, Linkage kits, Leveling Valves, Relay
and emergency Valves, Air line filters, Shut off Valves, Governor, Hand and Foot Valves, Fourway
Protection Valves. Hydraulic, Electrical and Air Fittings.

#### TRUCK & TRAILER Batteries & Electrical

Commercial Batteries, Agricultural Batteries, Battery Clamps, Fuses, Cables, Globes, Lights, LED
Lights, EBS and ABS Cables, Black Mambas, Green Mambas, Tail Lights, Plugs and Junction Boxes.

#### TRUCK & TRAILER Accessories

Tailboards, Wheel Spanners, Straps, Ratchets, Corner Plates, Tarpaulins, Cargo Nets, Cargo Keepers,
Tautliner Uprights, Oils, Lubricants, Solvents, Jacks,  Catwalks, Tyre Pressure Gauges, Diesel
Tanks, Fuel Caps and Fuel Savers.

#### TRAILER PARTS - Safety

Keep your trailer up to standard and safe.  We supply all Trailer Safety Parts such as Warning
Lights, Warning Triangles, Chevrons and Reflective Tape, Fire Extinguishers, Wheel Chocks, Strobe
Lights, Reflective Jackets and PPE.

throughout South Africa, Swaziland & Mozambique. As official agents and with our network of

Welcome to Xtreme
Enterprises South Africa

Partner with Xtreme Enterprises, a top choice for high-quality fashionable alloy wheels. Elevate
your business with our extensive range, unmatched service, and commitment to your excellence.

### What Sets Us Apart?

### Partnership

At Xtreme, we believe in forming partnerships, not just transactions. As your business partner, we
go beyond providing wheels – we offer a comprehensive support system designed to help you grow and
thrive in your market. Whether you’re a fitment centre or auto part accessory shop, we understand
your unique challenges and are committed to helping you overcome them. By choosing Xtreme, you’re
choosing a partner who is invested in your long-term success.

### Smart Solutions for Profitable Growth

Offering competitive rates is only part of our strategy. Our real focus is on ensuring your
profitability through wheels that balance quality, design, and affordability. By leveraging our deep
expertise and supply chain knowledge, we support you in cutting costs, improving margins, and
delivering the best products to your customers, empowering your business to grow profitably

### Invested in Your Growth

Your success is our success, and we take that commitment seriously. Our team brings years of
industry experience, which we’re eager to share with you. Through tailored seminars, workshops, and
one-on-one consulting, we equip you with the tools and knowledge to market your business more
effectively, manage your inventory more efficiently, and increase your bottom line. Our hands-on
marketing training, designed specifically for the auto parts industry, teaches you how to position
your products, connect with your customers, and build a brand that stands out in a crowded
marketplace.

### A Partner You Can Trust

In a fast-paced, competitive industry, trust is everything. Our partner-based approach means that
when we say we’ll deliver, we do. With Xtreme, you can rest easy knowing that you have a partner who
not only understands your needs but also delivers on promises. We’re not just suppliers; we’re your
growth partner, committed to helping you succeed in every aspect of your business.

[Become a Partner Today - Contact Us][22]

### Our History

### 2 Decades of Innovation and Growth

Founded in 2002, Xtreme Enterprises began with a simple mission: to provide the automotive industry
with high-quality alloy wheels that combine both performance and design. Over the past two decades,
we’ve grown from a small operation into the largest importer of wheels in Southern Africa, serving
over 800 dealers nationwide. Our commitment to delivering superior products, coupled with a passion
for customer service, quickly set us apart in the highly competitive automotive and remodeling
industry.

As demand for premium wheels grew, so did our reach. We expanded our operations into neighboring
countries, including Botswana, Namibia, Swaziland, Mozambique, and Lesotho, solidifying our position
as a trusted partner throughout Southern Africa.

For 22 years, we’ve stayed at the forefront of innovation, continuously updating our product range
to reflect the latest trends in the automotive world. Our unwavering dedication to quality and
customer satisfaction has made Xtreme Enterprises a leader in both local and international markets,
and we remain committed to driving our clients’ success for decades to come.
